explanation: Raniere panel cites Inland Steel as its Buckhannon reading and does not overrule it; any shift from a merits requirement rests expressly on the intervening Supreme Court decision in CRST, a recognised ground.

Three-justice Beaumont panel expressly overruled its own Jackson to the extent of conflict, citing only that section 5(b) was not argued there; no higher-court, en banc or statutory-change ground relied on. Prior-panel rule and TRAP 41.2 en banc from own knowledge.

Fifth Circuit panel 'disapproved' any Burns language suggesting prejudgment interest alongside liquidated damages, but framed it as clarifying imprecise wording; Burns's actual holding on backpay interest is not in the text given, so departure from a holding cannot be settled.

Fourth DCA receded from State ex rel. Guterma v. Douglas, not the named Second DCA Allstate v. Jackson (shared page cite); nine judges participated, so the receding was by the court en banc, not a panel.

Ninth Circuit panel merely cited Seward as an example of the market participant exception applying and distinguished the California statute as regulatory; it did not overrule, disapprove or refuse to follow Seward.
